title: Neural Architecture Discovery via Autonomous Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2507.18074v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent progress in LLM agents has advanced the prospect of autonomous research. Yet whether AI can complete difficult long-horizon tasks, especially those that advance AI research itself, remains largely unexplored. We present ASI-Arch, a system for AI-driven AI research that autonomously conducts neural architecture research through a closed-loop research-experiment-analyze-update process. Applied to linear attention, ASI-Arch ran 1,773 iterative experiments and discovered 105 state-of-the-art architectures. Its best architecture improves over DeltaNet by nearly three times the gain achieved by Mamba2. Beyond the final performance gains, we analyze the contributions of different parts of the framework in this hard research setting, shedding light on what enables autonomous progress in complex AI research tasks.

translated_title: 通过自主进化进行神经架构发现
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体的最新进展推动了自主研究的前景。然而，AI能否完成困难的长周期任务，尤其是那些能够推进AI研究本身的任务，在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们提出了ASI-Arch，这是一个AI驱动的AI研究系统，通过闭环的“研究-实验-分析-更新”流程自主开展神经架构研究。应用于线性注意力领域，ASI-Arch运行了1,773次迭代实验，发现了105个最先进的架构。其最佳架构相比DeltaNet的改进幅度接近Mamba2所取得提升的三倍。除了最终的性能提升之外，我们还在这一艰难的研究场景中分析了框架各部分的贡献，揭示了使复杂AI研究任务中的自主进步成为可能的关键因素。
tldr: 提出ASI-Arch系统，通过闭环的“研究-实验-分析-更新”流程实现AI驱动的自主AI研究，运行1773次实验发现了105个最先进的线性注意力架构，其最佳架构性能提升接近Mamba2的三倍。
en_tdlr: ASI-Arch enables AI-driven autonomous AI research through a closed-loop research-experiment-analyze-update process, conducting 1,773 experiments to discover 105 state-of-the-art linear attention architectures, with the best one achieving nearly three times the improvement of Mamba2 over DeltaNet.
